description: KAYAK hotel prices for a city (KAYAK compares booking sites and hotel websites): the city's lowest nightly price headline and KAYAK's 'best hotels' list (usually ~16) with name, star rating, street address, price shown per night in USD, guest rating out of 10 with review count, phone and KAYAK hotel URL. The city is matched with KAYAK's own place search. Prices are KAYAK's recent prices on its public city page, not a live date search. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

city.description: City name, e.g. Paris, New York, Rome
